scope: AI-assisted architecture and targeted semantic QA for stages 10-12

decisions.finding: A provision-level modality can be corrupted when the same structural node also contains exception text with a different modality.
decisions.action: Added atomic-rule decomposition and stored modality, statement type, conditions, measurements and references separately for each atomic rule.

decisions.finding: Standalone enumerator fragments such as '1.' were initially emitted as empty exception rules.
decisions.action: Filtered enumerator-only fragments from the atomic-rule layer.

decisions.finding: Free-text subjects would create excessive one-off entity URIs.
decisions.action: Added an auditable concept-mapping layer for common accessibility concepts while retaining original subject text.

decisions.finding: SHACL initially failed because validation used only the entity graph while source-node types are defined in the document graph, and the Shape allowed only Provision sources.
decisions.action: Validated the union of document and entity graphs and constrained sourceNode to BuildingCodeEntity, allowing provisions, list items and exceptions.

important_boundary: AI was used to diagnose representation errors and review samples. It did not certify legal correctness, and 86 complex semantic objects remain in the manual review queue.
